panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Up means Prometheus reaches zkboost. Validator means zkboost is ready to prove and sign.

panels.title: Payload Age
panels.description: Time since the slot start of the newest valid payload. It grows when the CL stops sending payloads.

panels.title: Queue Depth
panels.description: Proofs waiting for a prover, per proof type.

panels.title: engine_newPayloadV5 Arrival
panels.description: Time from the slot start until zkboost receives the payload. Bars show the payloads later than 12 s per minute.

panels.title: engine_newPayloadWithWitnessV5 Status
panels.description: EL answers to new payloads. Only VALID payloads are proven.

panels.title: engine_newPayloadWithWitnessV5 Duration
panels.description: Mean round trip of the calls that returned a witness.

panels.title: Prove Duration
panels.description: Prove time of successful proofs. Red is one slot (12 s).

panels.title: Prove Duration Distribution
panels.description: Successful proofs per prove duration bucket in the selected time range.

panels.title: Proof Latency
panels.description: Time from the slot start until a proof is accepted. Red is one slot (12 s).
Proof results per proof type in the selected time range. On time means accepted within 12 s of the slot start.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="12.0"}[$__range])) / (sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"}[$__range])) - sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="12.0"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Proof Outcomes
Prove Duration ($proof_type)
panels.description: Successful proofs per prove duration bucket and time step.

targets.expr: (sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="36.0"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="36.0"} offset $__interval, 0)) - sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="12.0"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="12.0"} offset $__interval, 0))) * 60000 / $__interval_ms

(sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="120.0"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="120.0"} offset $__interval, 0)) - sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="36.0"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="36.0"} offset $__interval, 0))) * 60000 / $__interval_ms

(sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="600.0"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="600.0"} offset $__interval, 0)) - sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="120.0"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="120.0"} offset $__interval, 0))) * 60000 / $__interval_ms

(sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"} offset $__interval, 0)) - sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="600.0"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="600.0"} offset $__interval, 0))) * 60000 / $__interval_ms

panels.title: Late Proof ($proof_type)
panels.description: Accepted proofs per minute, by time from the slot start.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="payload_arrival"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="payload_arrival"} offset $__rate_interval, 0)) / sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="payload_arrival"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="payload_arrival"} offset $__rate_interval, 0))

sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="witness_fetch"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="witness_fetch"} offset $__rate_interval, 0)) / sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="witness_fetch"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="witness_fetch"} offset $__rate_interval, 0))

sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="queue_wait"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="queue_wait"} offset $__rate_interval, 0)) / sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="queue_wait"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="queue_wait"} offset $__rate_interval, 0))

sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="prove"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="prove"} offset $__rate_interval, 0)) / sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="prove"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="prove"} offset $__rate_interval, 0))

sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="submission"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="submission"} offset $__rate_interval, 0)) / sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="submission"} - zkboost_proof_step_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", step="submission"} offset $__rate_interval, 0))

sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_sum{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"} offset $__rate_interval, 0)) / sum(clamp_min(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"} - zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"} offset $__rate_interval, 0))
